steelmen.strongest_admission_case: C-PETROV is the strongest current mechanism: a genuinely distinct test space is outside NC-SAME-SPACE, its two-node local mass determinant is exactly positive under positive weights and separated nodes, and conditional thermal-tail bounds show compactification with an exact p test is not intrinsically divergent. C-ANALYTIC and moving-remap MEDVM remain real escape hatches, so no universal no-go is justified.
steelmen.strongest_rejection_case: The gate is conjunctive and candidate-wide. No candidate supplies a complete operator and consumer graph, process-total finite-m_e shell, exact candidate-wide entropy and invariants, one directed half-line tail, deterministic Jacobian/permutation semantics, exact B3-v2 non-isomorphism, a uniform condition certificate, a prospective binary64 certificate, and both cost thresholds. The registered cost screen itself fails.
steelmen.decisive_future_reversal: One prospectively sealed candidate artifact must discharge every candidate-specific and common obligation with no deferred branch, consumer, theorem, or implementation choice. Only then could G-EXT-FEASIBILITY pass, after which a separate explicit OWNER-1 decision would still be required.

findings.statement: NC-SAME-SPACE is proved on all five independent axes under aligned assumptions. A finite constant-coefficient span of terminal-vanishing functions also vanishes at the endpoint, so it cannot exactly contain 1 or p_star*xi/(1-xi) on a terminal interval. This rejects only the same trial/test-space PCR-DG wording; it does not reject a genuinely distinct Petrov test space or an analytic nonvanishing component.

Coefficients are finite constants independent of xi.
Every terminal basis function has left endpoint limit zero.
Exact representation is pointwise equality on a nonempty terminal interval.
p_star>0 and xi approaches 1 from below.

findings.statement: The registered cost obligation fails. The compactified range of 800-1500 LOC and possible net deletion of 600-1700 straddles both hard thresholds and cannot be credited at favorable endpoints. No candidate proves permanent LOC<=800 and same-change net deletion<=-1000. This is a failure of the registered cost claims, not a universal complexity lower bound.
